name: store every point in the frame of each basis pair, then vote at query time
mechanism: offline, for every ordered pair of model points as a basis, express all other model points in that basis and store (quantised coordinates -> model, basis) in a table; online, pick a basis from the scene, express the scene points in it, look each up and vote; a model-basis pair with many votes is a match under the transformation

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Geometric hashing' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: a method for efficiently finding two-dimensional objects represented by discrete points that have undergone an affine transformation

requires: a transformation group fixed by two points
fails_when: table size is cubic in model points; quantisation boundaries lose votes
